# Tabler Icons

The `ic_tabler_*.xml` Android vector drawables in `app/src/main/res/drawable/`
are adapted from the outline icons in [Tabler Icons v3.36.0](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.36.0).
Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tabler/icons/-/icons-3.36.0.tgz

The original SVG path data, 24 × 24 viewport, stroke width of 2, and round caps
and joins are preserved. White strokes allow Android and Compose to apply the
current icon tint. The back arrow mirrors automatically for RTL layouts.
The app launcher artwork is separate from these interface icons.
